title: Apache Iceberg Table Metadata Structure
description: Field documentation for Apache Iceberg table metadata objects

fields.name: format-version
fields.description: Iceberg spec version: 1 (original) or 2 (adds row-level deletes)

fields.name: table-uuid
fields.description: Globally unique table identifier, assigned at creation

fields.name: location
fields.description: Base storage path for all table data and metadata files

fields.name: schemas
fields.description: All schema versions, supporting schema evolution

fields.name: current-schema-id
fields.description: Points to the active schema in the schemas array

fields.name: partition-specs
fields.description: Partition strategies for organizing data files

fields.name: snapshots
fields.description: Immutable table states enabling time travel queries

fields.name: current-snapshot-id
fields.description: The active snapshot representing the current table state

fields.name: sort-orders
fields.description: Defines data sorting for write optimization

fields.name: refs
fields.description: Named references (branches and tags) pointing to snapshots
